# algebraic closure　`def.algebraic-closure`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.algebraic-closure)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.algebraic-closure.md)

1. $\bar K$ is **algebraically closed** (every nonconstant polynomial has a root in $\bar K$, see `def.algebraically-closed`);
2. $\bar K / K$ is an **algebraic extension** (every element is a root of some nonzero polynomial over $K$).

By Zorn's lemma every field has an algebraic closure; and any two algebraic closures are $K$-isomorphic (unique up to isomorphism).
